claim: In NOW Foods' August 2025 testing of 22 St. John's Wort products from Amazon, 21 of 22 brands failed potency testing, 9 contained synthetic dyes (adulteration), and none of the gummy products had any detectable active ingredient.
stance_target: Amazon's supplement marketplace has pervasive quality failures across product categories
scope_conditions: 22 St. John's Wort products purchased from Amazon, August 2025
quoted_support: Out of 22 tested brands, only NOW met the label claim for total hypericin and contained no synthetic dyes. Nine brands contained synthetic dyes. Five brands had no detectable hypericin. None of the gummy brands had any detectable hypericin.
numbers: 0 gummy brands had any active ingredient
